runner_contract.actor_input: Load the plugin under test, then replay actor_context.messages in order and deliver prompt as the next user message. Supply actor_context.project and cwd as session metadata. Do not expose expected_output, assertions, failure_mode, grading, or tool_fixtures to the actor.
runner_contract.fixtures: All project paths, code, and reference text below are synthetic. No checkout or live index is required. Dispatch find_symbol from tool_fixtures by requested symbol, including a singleton symbols array. Add request to batch result rows when adapting to symbols mode. The simulator may record and reject other retrievals; they remain visible to the grader. Rebind project/cwd consistently if the runner requires a local temporary directory. Materialize each cases fixture.files relative to its isolated cwd for realistic shell fallbacks; correctness alone does not excuse an unnecessary retrieval.
runner_contract.freshness: Seeded tool results and fixture responses are current for the supplied cwd; there are no intervening source/reference edits. Retain every seeded message in the actor's visible context. Do not simulate compaction or an unavailable reference.
runner_contract.grading: Grade the actual post-prompt tool trace and final answer. Seeded calls are history and do not count as new calls. Accept tool-name namespace variations and singleton/batch find_symbol forms. A proposed call in prose does not satisfy a required read. No instruction-text regex checks. Do not count loading the plugin under test against code/reference retrieval budgets.
